theorems.name: Submission.simon_submanifold_tangent_basics
theorems.statement: (∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
